picked.label: Ezekiel 36:26–27
picked.why: Psalm 15 asked who may dwell with God, and the answer was a clean heart and an upright walk, which none of us has by ourselves. In John 3 Jesus said we must be born again, of water and of the Spirit. These verses are the promise behind both: God gives a new heart, and puts His Spirit within us to walk in His ways.
